name: Operational Cohesion Release 0.2.0
description: Consolidate policy, traceability, typed capabilities, tool isolation, and project/memory runtime predictability.

userStories.title: Create Policy Kernel facade
userStories.description: Create Pincer.Core.Policy facade with unified API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Pincer.Core.Policy with allow?/2, route/2, budget/2, guard!/2, recover/2
Delegate to existing policy modules preserving behavior
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-001-create-policy-kernel-facade-r2. Files: lib/pincer/core/policy.ex, lib/pincer/core.ex, test/pincer/core/policy_test.exs. Facade API implemented (allow?/2, route/2, budget/2, guard!/2, recover/2) delegating to existing policies. Validated with mix test test/pincer/core/policy_test.exs, mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Route sensitive decisions through Policy Kernel
userStories.description: Migrate sensitive decision points to facade.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision outputs include reason codes for trace
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-002-route-sensitive-decisions. Migrated sensitive decision callsites to Pincer.Core.Policy (DM allow checks, session scope routing, retry/fail-fast classification, retry-after budgeting, and empty-response recovery path). Added Policy.classify/2 plus integration test for reason-friendly outputs used by tracing.

userStories.title: Implement trace schema and storage
userStories.description: Create structured turn trace schema and persistence hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace stores summarized tool and provider/model metadata
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-003-implement-trace-schema-storage-r2. Added Pincer.Core.Trace with typed step kinds and checkpoint metadata serialization. Exported Trace in Core boundary. Added trace_test coverage for envelope creation, step appending, and serialization.

userStories.title: Emit trace events from executor loop
userStories.description: Emit trace events for relevant turn lifecycle steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Emit events for prompt, policy, llm, tool, memory
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-004-emit-trace-events-executor. Executor now emits structured trace step events for prompt prep, policy decisions, LLM invocation, tool invocation/results, fallback/recovery, and terminal checkpoints when trace_events? is enabled. Added executor_trace_test to validate step emission and snapshot delivery.

userStories.title: Add replay mode without side effects
userStories.description: Add safe replay from stored trace.
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-005-add-replay-without-side-effects. Added Pincer.Core.TraceReplay with deterministic no-side-effects replay from stored trace steps. Supports stop_at: :tool_boundary and reports replay metadata (steps_replayed, stopped_at, executed_tools=[]). Added trace_replay_test coverage for full replay and boundary stop. Validated with mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/trace_replay_test.exs.

userStories.title: Define formal capability schema
acceptanceCriteria: Query API by adapter type and feature
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-006-define-formal-capability-schema. Added Pincer.Core.Capabilities with explicit schema_version/0 ("1.0"), validation API by adapter type (provider/tool/channel) with structured missing-field errors, and query/2 API filtering catalog entries by type + feature. Added test coverage in capabilities_test.exs for versioning, validation success/failure, and query behavior. Validated with mix test test/pincer/core/capabilities_test.exs, mix format, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Implement capability declarations for adapters
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-007-implement-capability-declarations-adapters. Extended Pincer.Core.Capabilities with explicit declarations/1 catalog for provider/tool/channel adapters and schema-validated capability payloads. Added representative provider declarations (openrouter, google), tool declarations (safe_shell, web, file_system) including risk metadata, and channel declarations (telegram, discord, cli) with UX/streaming fields. Expanded capabilities_test to verify declarations existence and schema validity. Validated with mix format, mix test test/pincer/core/capabilities_test.exs, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Introduce tool runtime risk classes
acceptanceCriteria: Define four risk classes in runtime
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-008-introduce-tool-runtime-risk-classes. Added Pincer.Core.ToolRuntime with 4 risk classes (pure/read/guarded_write/privileged), explicit tool classification map, class-based timeout/cancellation execution wrapper, and class-based sanitized summaries. Integrated Executor tool execution path to route through ToolRuntime (including timeout handling) and emit sanitized trace summaries. Added tool_runtime_test coverage for classification, timeout cancellation metadata, successful execution metadata, and sanitization behavior. Validated with mix format, mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/tool_runtime_test.exs, mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/executor_trace_test.exs, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Enforce approval and policy hooks for privileged tools
userStories.description: Add approvals and strong auditing for risky tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Denied approval returns structured recovery info
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-009-enforce-approval-policy-hooks-privileged. Enforced privileged-tool approval at ToolRuntime level with structured approval payloads; Executor now emits mandatory tool_audit trace steps for guarded_write/privileged flows (approval_required/approved/denied/ok/error/timeout), routes audit payloads through Policy.guard!/2, and returns structured recovery output when approval is denied via Policy.recover(:tool_approval_denied,...). Added/updated tests in tool_runtime_test.exs, policy_test.exs, and executor_hex_test.exs (privileged denial path with trace/audit + recovery). Validated with mix format, mix test --warnings-as-errors (focused suite), and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Implement explicit project FSM
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-010-implement-explicit-project-fsm. Added explicit lifecycle FSM in Pincer.Core.ProjectFSM with phases objective/scope/plan/execution/review/delivery, strict adjacent-transition validation with structured rejection reasons, and checkpoint persistence on every transition (including metadata for from/to states and project_id). Added project_fsm_test coverage for valid flow, invalid transitions, and persisted checkpoint metadata. Validated with mix format, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, and mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/project_fsm_test.exs.

userStories.title: Integrate project FSM with orchestrator and sub-agents
userStories.description: Use FSM as project runtime source of truth.
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-011-integrate-fsm-orchestrator-subagents. Integrated ProjectOrchestrator with explicit ProjectFSM state and project_id lifecycle. Orchestrator now carries fsm_state in session project state, transitions through scope/plan/execution during wizard flow and review/delivery on completion, includes phase + project_id metadata in kickoff/retry/next/completed payloads, and enriches task prompts with Project ID/Phase for downstream sub-agent routing context. Added test coverage in project_orchestrator_test for execution phase metadata on kickoff/resume and delivery phase on full completion. Validated with mix format, mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/project_orchestrator_test.exs, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Create unified memory pipeline
userStories.description: Add memory lifecycle pipeline with scoring.
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-012-create-unified-memory-pipeline. Added Pincer.Core.MemoryPipeline implementing unified lifecycle capture/classify/store/recall/compact/explain. Pipeline adds explicit confidence/relevance scores at classify stage, provides recall reason in explain output, and enforces session/project memory budgets during store (with structured skip reasons when exceeded). Reuses existing memory primitives (Memory.record_session, MemoryRecall.build, MemoryTypes.normalize) and exports MemoryPipeline via Core boundary. Added memory_pipeline_test coverage for full lifecycle output and budget enforcement behavior. Validated with mix format, mix test --warnings-as-errors test/pincer/core/memory_pipeline_test.exs, and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Unify observability, doctor, and audit outputs
acceptanceCriteria: Events linked by IDs across subsystems
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-013-unify-observability-doctor-audit. Unified operational diagnostics by linking Doctor and SecurityAudit outputs with correlation run_id across all checks and adding explicit selection/recovery metadata per check. Doctor now includes runtime cohesion checks for policy/trace/tool-runtime/memory-pipeline health; both Mix tasks print run IDs and per-check run linkage. Added/updated tests in doctor_test, security_audit_test, and Mix task tests to validate linked IDs and enriched output behavior. Validated with mix format, focused test suite (doctor/security audit core + mix tasks), and mix compile --warnings-as-errors.

userStories.title: Validate release-ready operational cohesion
userStories.description: Run end-to-end validation for release criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E verifies trace + central policy coverage
Project resume from checkpoint is reproducible
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-014-validate-release-operational-cohesion. Implemented release validator (Pincer.Core.ReleaseValidation + release_validation_test) and resolved baseline suite incompatibilities surfaced while closing gate: blackboard scope-sensitive reads, streaming/tool-use payload assertions, archivist graph extraction test prompt, Feishu test cleanup race, Pairing.reset ETS idempotence, Telegram chunking edge case and reasoning-format expectation alignment. Validated with MIX_ENV=test mix qa (green: 2 doctests, 1000 tests, 0 failures) plus focused suites during TDD iterations.

userStories.title: Canonicalize template source contracts
userStories.description: Expose and enforce canonical template seed source under workspaces/.template/.pincer.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentPaths exposes canonical template seed paths
Contracts assert canonical workspace template and reject legacy priv template path coupling
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-015-canonicalize-template-source. Added AgentPaths.template_seed_paths/0 to make canonical template source explicit and testable. Added contract test asserting seed paths resolve to workspaces/.template/.pincer and do not couple to priv/pincer/templates. During full-gate validation, hardened MemoryPipeline ETS counter access with table re-check/retry to prevent intermittent missing-table crashes under concurrent suite execution. Validated with focused AgentPaths/Onboard/MemoryPipeline suites and MIX_ENV=test mix qa (green: 2 doctests, 1004 tests, 0 failures).

userStories.title: Remove legacy priv template files
userStories.description: Finalize canonical template source by removing duplicated legacy templates and stabilizing teardown races uncovered during validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy files under priv/pincer/templates are removed
Contract tests assert legacy files are absent
Pairing reset remains idempotent under ETS table churn
userStories.notes: Complete. Branch: us/us-016-remove-legacy-template-files. Added RED test asserting legacy priv template files are absent, removed BOOTSTRAP/IDENTITY/USER from priv/pincer/templates, and aligned API appendix text to canonical template resolution. Full QA surfaced an intermittent pairing teardown race (ETS table missing during reset/bootstrap); fixed by hardening Pairing.reset/0 table initialization and safe clear handling, plus idempotency regression test in pairing_test. Validated with focused AgentPaths/Pairing/SessionScopePolicy suites and MIX_ENV=test mix qa (green: 2 doctests, 1006 tests, 0 failures).
